inlines.v: FILTH'Y, adjective 1. Dirty; foul; unclean; nasty. 2. Polluted; defiled by sinful practices; morally impure. He that is filthy let him be filthy still. Revelation 22:11. 3. Obtained by base and dishonest means; as filthy lucre. Titus 1:7.
